opportunities.name: Kayak hotel stay search
opportunities.description: Search for hotel stays on Kayak by destination, check-in/check-out dates, and room/adult/child counts, then optionally sort results by price.
steps: Click 'Stays' in the left sidebar.
Click the 'Enter a city, hotel, airport, address or landmark' field and type the destination; pick the matching suggestion from the dropdown.
Click the check-in date field and select the check-in date in the calendar.
Click the check-out date field and select the check-out date.
Click the guests field, set Rooms, Adults and Children with the +/- controls (add a child age if children > 0).
Click the orange search button.
Optionally click 'Sorted by' and choose 'Price (low to high)'.

instances.values: Le Marais, Paris, France; Mon 3/27 to Sun 4/2; 2 rooms, 3 guests; sorted by price low to high
Santa Fe, New Mexico, United States; Fri 6/16 to Sun 6/18; 2 rooms, 3 guests (search clicked; results not captured)
Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Varanasi; Tue 6/6 to Sat 6/10; 2 rooms, 4 guests incl. one child aged 7; results then filtered
Los Angeles, California, United States; Sun 5/21 to Tue 5/23; 1 room, 2 guests

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways one-way flight search with passenger mix
opportunities.description: Search one-way flights on the Qatar Airways Book tab by origin, destination, departure date and passenger counts (adults/children/infants) with cabin class, then pick a fare.
steps: Click the 'From' field, type the origin city or code and select the airport suggestion.
Click the 'To' field, type the destination city or code and select the airport suggestion.
Set Trip to 'One way' in the Trip dropdown.
Click the 'Depart' field and choose the departure date in the calendar, then click Continue.
Click 'Passengers / Class' and use +/- to set Adults, Child and Infant counts; choose Economy or Premium(Business/First); click Confirm.
Click 'Show flights'.
On the results page, click the fare card for the desired cabin (Select fare / price box) and continue.

instances.values: Colombo CMB to New York JFK, 24 Jun 2023, 2 adults + 1 child, Premium; Business fare selected for outbound and return Doha-New York
Doha DOH to Durban DUR, 28 May 2023, 2 adults + 1 infant (3 passengers), Economy; Economy fare QAR 4,980 selected

opportunities.name: Hotel search on Qatar Airways hotel partners (Expedia / Booking.com)
opportunities.description: From Qatar Airways' Book > Hotel menu, search partner hotel sites by destination, check-in/out dates and guests, then sort or filter results.
opportunities.site: qatarairways.com (Book > Hotel) redirecting to Expedia and Booking.com
steps: Click 'Book' in the Qatar Airways top nav, then click 'Hotel' in the menu.
Click the destination field and type the city; select the suggestion.
Pick check-in and check-out dates in the calendar.
Set adults and rooms in the guests dropdown.
Click 'Search'.
On results, open the sort control and choose the desired order (e.g. Price (lowest first)); on Booking.com, use the neighbourhood and star-rating filters as needed.

instances.values: Las Vegas, Nevada; Mon 4/10 to Sun 4/16 (Expedia-powered page); 2 adults, 1 room; sorted by price lowest first
Washington, District of Columbia (Booking.com); Mon 6/5 to Tue 6/6; 4 adults, 2 rooms; Downtown DC neighbourhood and 5-star filters; St. Regis reserved
